text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Mix the flour, sugar, and eggs, and... um, 
what was next again...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...What was I supposed to do next...?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... I can't remember. Even though I 
stayed up late memorizing it, to end up 
right back at square one...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Will I finish making the chiffon cake in 
time for the tea party with 
McQueen-san...?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"—No, I must properly memorize the recipe 
and learn how to make it... *yawn*."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems Satono Diamond didn't get much 
sleep...
